title: Addition of the Adaptor to RNA Substrates for 5′ RACE
author: Matus Valach
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xsrfnd6

steps.title: Prepare adaptor ligation mix
steps.instruction: Combine the specified components in a total volume of 10 µL, including the hydroxylated 5′ and 3′ ends of the 5′ RACE oligo.

steps.title: Denature ligation mixture
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture for 2 min at 70 °C, then immediately place on ice.

steps.title: Add ligation reaction components
steps.instruction: Add the remaining components to reach a total volume of 20 µL as indicated.

steps.title: Incubate ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the 20 µL reaction for 60 min at 25 °C, then 60 min at 16 °C, and finally 120 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Purify ligated RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA from the ligation reaction using trizol extraction or a column‑based clean‑up.

steps.title: Perform RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Carry out reverse transcription followed by PCR using the adaptor‑ligated RNA.

substeps.instruction: Reverse transcription: use 250–500 ng of the purified adaptor‑ligated RNA with random hexamers (or a primer of choice).
PCR: use a forward primer that binds the 5′ adaptor and a reverse primer that binds the RNA of interest.
